text: かのじょに　ピッピにんぎょう　プレゼント　するんだ！

structure.jp: ピッピにんぎょう　プレゼント　するんだ！
structure.en: I'm going to give a Poké Doll as a gift!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end makes the sentence sound like you are telling someone your plan or explaining yourself. プレゼント　するんだ = 'I'm going to give it as a gift, you see'.
